tags.name: Dev feature
tags.description: In-development API surfaces. Hidden from public OpenAPI output unless dev features are enabled.

get.description: Returns only the published document, including the optional live-editor element overrides. The draft is never exposed here.
Returns the draft, the published document and the published version. Live-editor element overrides are kept on the document and in the version history.

put.description: Saves the ordered sections and the optional live-editor elements without publishing. elements is a record keyed by a stable authored element ID (letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, 1-100 characters; prototype-related keys are rejected). Each value accepts only optional text (max 1000), href (same-site path, section anchor or HTTPS URL, max 2048), src (HTTPS image URL, max 2048), alt (max 300), fit (cover or contain) and integer x/y offsets (-400 through 400). Documents without elements stay valid. The full request schema is generated from landingPageDocumentGuard.

post.summary: Suggest a landing page draft edit
post.description: Returns a validated AI-suggested document for the editor preview. It never saves or publishes the draft.

200.description: A suggested draft; it has not been saved.

403.description: The caller lacks the landing-page scope.

503.description: AI editing is unavailable or returned invalid output.
